title: 烫金一擦就掉的原因与解决方法

seo.title: 烫金一擦就掉的原因与解决方法

content:
## 内容定位

用于回答“为什么烫金一擦就掉？”“是不是膜不好？”“覆膜纸/PU皮/塑料件烫金不牢怎么办？”等高频故障问题。

## Reddit 英文短评版

If the foil transfers but rubs off easily, it is usually an adhesion issue.

I would check three things first: the surface treatment, the stamping temperature, and whether the foil adhesive layer is suitable for that substrate. Matte lamination, UV coating, PU leather and plastic surfaces can be difficult for a general paper foil.

A quick test: stamp the same foil on normal paper and on your actual substrate. If it only fails on the actual substrate, you probably need a foil grade made for that surface.

## PrintPlanet 技术长评版

When foil transfers visually but fails after rubbing or tape testing, the problem is normally related to adhesion rather than transfer appearance.

The main causes are:

1. The substrate surface has low surface energy or incompatible coating.

1. The foil adhesive layer is not designed for the top surface.

1. Stamping temperature or dwell time is too low to activate the adhesive layer.

1. Pressure is insufficient or uneven.

1. Ink, varnish, spray powder or contamination is present on the sheet.

The first diagnostic step is to test the same foil on a known paper stock. If adhesion is good there but poor on the actual printed or laminated sheet, the foil itself may be fine, but the adhesive layer is not suitable for the production surface.

For laminated paper, UV varnish, PU leather or plastic, a dedicated foil grade should be tested before mass production.

## 知乎中文科普版

烫金一擦就掉，通常不是“颜色不好”，而是附着力出了问题。

常见原因有：

1. 底材表面有覆膜、光油、油污、喷粉或特殊涂层。

1. 温度偏低，胶层没有充分活化。

1. 压力不足，膜和底材没有充分贴合。

1. 停留时间太短。

1. 烫金膜胶层不适合这个底材。

判断方法很简单：把同一款膜分别烫在普通纸张和实际材料上。如果普通纸张牢固，但实际材料一擦就掉，说明问题大概率出在底材表面和胶层匹配上。

所以采购前一定要做实际材料打样，尤其是覆膜纸、UV光油面、塑料件和PU皮。

## 阿里国际站成交版

If the foil transfers but rubs off easily, it may be caused by poor adhesion between the foil adhesive layer and your substrate.

This often happens on matte laminated paper, gloss laminated paper, UV varnished paper, PU leather or plastic surfaces.

We suggest testing with your real production material. We can provide several foil grades for comparison:

- Standard paper foil

- Laminated paper foil

- Plastic foil

- Leather foil

- High-adhesion foil

Please share your substrate and current stamping parameters, and we will suggest the right grade for sample testing.

## 自然 CTA

We can provide color cards, sample rolls and substrate-based foil recommendations before bulk ordering.
